$comment: A service's stored fields, by the founder's rulings of 18/11/2026 on the ID-3944 field names. The address (slug) and the editor's order are each platform's own (SC-003). The view's document (fixtures/service) is these fields as the service view receives them, with relatedServices resolved to cards for display (related).
label: Service

nextjs.owes: a count as the editor types that notes a title past about 60 characters and notes more strongly one past 120, never refused

wordpress.owes: a count as the editor types that notes a title past about 60 characters and notes more strongly one past 120, never refused
the taxonomy box labelled Topics, with no parent control

fields.name: summary
fields.label: Summary
fields.description: One or two sentences, shown on cards wherever the item is listed.

nextjs.owes: a target of 300 characters, shown with a count and never refused

wordpress.formerly: summary (an ACF textarea with no limit)
wordpress.owes: the summary stored in the excerpt, with a target of 300 characters, shown with a count and never refused

fields.name: icon
fields.label: Icon
fields.description: Optional. Drawn on the service's card when it has no image.

wordpress.owes: a select of the icon names in place of free text

fields.name: intro
fields.label: Introduction
fields.description: The opening of the service page.

nextjs.owes: the field in core; sites add their own today

wordpress.owes: the restricted list: paragraphs, bold, italic, links and lists

nextjs.owes: the field in core, in place of the upload field a site names (imageField)

wordpress.formerly: the featured image, which no card reads
wordpress.owes: reading it on the service's card

fields.name: benefits
fields.label: Benefits
fields.description: Optional. When given, at least one; aim for no more than 12.

wordpress.owes: the name text in place of benefit, required

nextjs.owes: the minimum of one, and a target of 12, shown with a count and never refused

wordpress.owes: the minimum of one, and a target of 12, shown with a count and never refused

fields.name: priceFrom
fields.label: Price from
fields.description: Optional. As it should read, such as £500 or POA.

wordpress.owes: text named priceFrom in place of a number

fields.name: relatedServices
fields.label: Related services
fields.description: Optional. Other services, never this one; aim for no more than six.

nextjs.owes: a target of six, shown with a count and never refused

wordpress.owes: the name relatedServices, a target of six, shown with a count and never refused, and refusing the service itself
the contract's link shape in place of ACF's link, so an internal link holds the document it points at

dropped.note: An H1 different from the title; no view reads it, and the title is the page's one name.

display.$comment: Derived from Salt for Next.js's READ_CARD (blocks/collection-showcase/module.ts) and Salt for WordPress's inc/sections/services.php, with the rc.7 names.

href.note: The service's own page. Routing is each platform's own.

image.note: Salt for Next.js reads a field the site names today; Salt for WordPress draws no card image today.

icon.note: Drawn only when the card has no image.

tags.note: When the section shows tags. Each topic's title.
